title: Seeking Support During a Serious Financial Hardship
author: Little-Definition-29
selftext:
I never imagined I would be in a position like this, but I have lost everything and am currently struggling to meet even my most basic expenses. This is not easy for me to say, but I truly need support during this difficult time.

Any contribution, no matter how small—even $10—would make a meaningful difference and help me begin to recover.
